card.name: Volume units and 'of' after amounts
card.fires_on: The unit mL, ml or cc after a number, and the word 'of' right after such a volume, when a liquid is being measured out or diluted.

modes.label: 'of' after volume
modes.description: The word 'of' following a number and mL, before the name of a liquid.

modes.label: Volume unit itself
modes.description: The unit mL, ml or cc right after a number.

card.plain: It marks the spot right after a liquid amount, such as 50 mL, where the name of the liquid usually comes next.
